text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (At the edge of my vision—a burst of light flashed.)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(A single streak of flash.
Seeing that, I...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Kh!?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash! It's Eishin Flash!
Claiming the Autumn Shield is Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Fan
text_block_list.text:
You did great out there, Fenomeno!!
It was so close! I'll be cheering for you next time too!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno! You were so cool!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...The victor today was me.
However, please take pride in your strength."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Flash-san...!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
It was a terrifying run.
Once she locked onto her target, she never eased up...
Chasing, passing, aiming straight for the lead.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
A strength born of blending diligence with boldness.
Allow me to praise your power and offer you my words.
—Your ability to "lock onto" your target is truly magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Thank you so very much
for the kind words!!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss!
Did you hear?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san acknowledged me!
She said I have wonderful power!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I had it in me too.
A strength all my own, capable of stirring someone's heart!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: "This strength will surely serve as my guidepost! Let's train hard so it becomes even greater combat power!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fenomeno happily gives her report, as if she had just found treasure for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
“—As a Trainer,
I have to nurture this joy.”

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Just as Flash-san took notice of!
I won't let any opponent or opportunity slip away! I'll lock on and—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I'll runnn!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (If I polish this power——)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOH!!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: (Even "I"—can captivate hearts!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Boss. For my next race, I request
to enter the Japan Cup!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
—Because Orfevre-san, the strongest active Umamusume,
will also be running in that race.
choice_data_list: It's finally time for a direct showdown...!
It's finally time for a direct showdown...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Orfevre.
The Umamusume who, more than anyone else in Japan recently,
let us dream of winning the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And no matter when, they are the one and only presence
who captures the hearts of children and adults alike
and never lets go."

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
It remains deeply engraved in my heart even now.
...The day when the children's admiration
was completely captivated by her.
choice_data_list: That was the day you worried about the end of the century, wasn't it?
That was the day you lamented the end of the century, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I have always thought so.
That someday, I must surpass her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
The time is now! With the strength I gained at the Autumn Tenno Sho!
And by demonstrating the weapon I honed in training, combined with a spoonful of good luck—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
We should be able to reach
a chance to surpass her!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, Fenomeno's next goal
was set for the Japan Cup.
